faqs.q: Sec. 54-37. - MTC Part 10 "Driving - Overtaking - Passing" amended.
faqs.a:
The Model Traffic Code is hereby amended by adding subsection (3) to section 1007
               of Part 10 to read as follows:
1007. Driving on roadways laned for traffic.
(3)
No person shall ride or operate a motorcycle or motor-driven vehicle within a bicycle
                  lane or path designated for the use of bicycles except for maintenance, construction
                  or emergency vehicles, temporarily disabled vehicles, electrical assisted bicycles
                  as defined in C.R.S. § 42-1-102(28.5), vehicles executing a legal parking maneuver,
                  passing a vehicle turning left, and buses entering or leaving the bicycle lane to
                  pick up or discharge passengers.
(
Ord. No. 4384, § 2, 4-15-2013
)
